<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates whose forward reaction forms a C‑C double bond and breaks an aldehyde functional group, which matches the Doebner modification.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
